ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the oath by Mount Sinai in Surah At-Tin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the oath by Mount Sinai (Tur Sinin) highlights the covenant between God and the Children of Israel, serving as a precursor to the final covenant established with Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Ahl al-Bayt. This reference underscores the continuity of divine revelation and the authority of the Prophet as the seal of the prophets who received the Torah.
